test.statistic: weighted out-of-fold AUC of a classifier telling the receivers' true target values from the imputed ones, on predictors and targets together
test.folds_over: receiver rows (both copies of a row share a fold)
test.null: the same test with the labels of a random half of the receiver rows swapped

value_reuse: shared_value_share: among receivers with a non-zero imputed value, the share whose value another receiver also has; shared_value_share_truth: the same for the true values

dollar_measures.within_group_wasserstein1: weighted Wasserstein-1 distance between imputed and true values inside each group of receivers, averaged by group weight
dollar_measures.ratios: imputed weighted mean and upper quantiles over the receivers, as multiples of the full sample's
